references.text: The angel of the Lord appeared to the woman for the first time, and now he returns in answer to Manoah's prayer.
Isaac prayed to the Lord on behalf of his wife, and the Lord answered him—a similar pattern where God hears a man's prayer concerning his wife.
God heard the boy's voice and sent his angel—the same pattern of God hearing and sending his angel in response.
The angel of the Lord found Hagar alone, just as the angel here comes to the woman while she is alone in the field.
The angel of the Lord appears repeatedly in the book of Judges with a special message.
